caseName: New York State Department of Social Services v. Dublino
caseNameFull: New York State Department of Social Services v. Dublino and Onondaga County Department of Social Services v. Dublino

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. W. D. N. Y. Motion of appellees for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Further consideration of question of jurisdiction postponed to hearing of cases on the merits. Cases consolidated and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 348 F. Supp. 290.
